items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: As I remember, who was the guy? Emil Knox. He played drums with them. He was a fairly old guy. He'd been playing with them for a long, long time. But, you know, I don't really remember...

ctx.x: Did you get the feeling that all the bands were organized, all the brass bands, or, you know, that...

Well, I guess my feeling was that they were... that they didn't always show up with the same people, obviously, but that there was a basic organization there, there was a basic membership, and that there was somebody that was in charge of sort of looking out and getting it all organized, and that it was an organization that had some continuity to it. I maybe didn't understand what all that was there, but my impression was that the Eurik and the Young Tuxedo in particular had been there for a long, long time, and…
They probably played eight or ten pieces in those bands, and, you know, ten.
